blocks.text: I smell the fragrance of the Sahabah (RA) coming from you." She would also place her hand on his head and say, "Why is it that I see the images of the Sahabah (RA) always with you?"
In fact, Hadhrat Sheikhul Hind Moulana Mahmoodul Hasan (RAH) used to say, "Whenever I see Moulana Muhammad Ilyaas, I think of the Sahabah (RA)."

Hadhrat Moulana Manzoor Nu'maani (RAH) wrote, "Myself and some of my friends blessed with spiritual light and deep insight are unanimous about the fact that the existence of Hadhrat Moulana Muhammad Ilyaas (RAH) in present times was a sign of the power of Allaah and a miracle of Rasulullaah ﷺ which proved the eternity and profound effect of the Deen and which portrayed in our time an example of the love, devotion and restlessness of the Sahabah (RA) for the Deen and their special attributes."

It is probably for this reason that Hadhrat Moulana Muhammad Ilyaas (RAH) used to have the stories of the Sahabah (RA) recited to him, causing him to become extremely happy and transporting him to another world. He made his nephew Hadhrat Sheikhul Hadith Moulana Muhammad Zakariyya (RAH) write the book "Hikaayaatus Sahabah (RA)" which contained stories of the Sahabah (RA) under various headings. The wide acceptance of this book can be judged from the fact that it has been translated into the major languages of the world including English, French and Japanese.

Hadhrat Moulana's son Hadhrat Moulana Muhammad Yusuf (RAH) inherited the love for Rasulullaah ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA) from his illustrious father. Even in his childhood he used to study the lives and reports of the Sahabah (RA). He enjoyed reading to himself and to others books such as "Samsaamul Islaam" and "Muhaarabaate Sahabah (RA)". During the lifetime of his father Hadhrat Moulana Muhammad Ilyaas (RAH), it was the duty of Hadhrat Moulana Muhammad Yusuf (RAH) to recite the books of Rasulullaah ﷺ's biography to his father after the Isha salaah. Even after his father passed away, it remained the practise of Hadhrat Moulana Muhammad Yusuf (RAH) to recite Hayaatus Sahabah (RA) after Isha. When he explained the incidents of the Sahabah (RA), it appeared as if he had seen them with his own eyes, that they were people of his household or that the incidents had taken place in front of him.

Hadhrat Moulana Muhammad Ilyaas (RAH) desired that the biographies of the Sahabah (RA) be presented in a manner that accented their efforts of Da'wah. For the compilation of such a book he chose his son Hadhrat Moulana Muhammad Yusuf (RAH). Hadhrat Moulana Muhammad Yusuf (RAH) set aside his work on the book "Amaanil Ahbaar" to complete this work, which was titled "Hayaatus Sahabah (RA)" on the recommendation of Hadhrat Moulana Abul Hasan Ali Nadwi (RAH). Notable scholars agree that no biography of the Sahabah (RA) as comprehensive as this has even been compiled.
